What is BIOMONIE?

A new form of
money access.

BIOMONIE is a payment platform that allows YOU (Finger or FACE) to be the money access for all payment activities — pay, receive payment or cash-related services. No pin, No password and Nothing else. Just show up, flex and pay.

Our Ecosystem powers everyday commerce for anyone; merchants, market traders, and agency banking operators across the globe with a world-class payment platform that works for everyone, everywhere.

Everybody earns in the BIOMONIE ecosystem: from the moment you join, you automatically become a Biomonie Affiliate and can grow your downlines and earn everytime transactions are performed.

Register Now — It's Free
How It Works

Four easy steps to
your new money access

BIOMONIE is sleek and easy by design. We do all the heavy lifting whilst YOU just show, flex and pay or spend.

Sign Up

Download the BIOMONIE App or visit a Merchant / Agent outlet to open a wallet with your NIN or BVN.

Transfer & Fund

Do a transfer into the ecosystem. A wallet linked to your NIN/BVN is created automatically with your funds in it.

Flex & Transact

Continuously Flex, Pay or Spend, Cash-in or Cash-out. YOU are the new money access.

Earn Perpetually

Every referral and transaction performed by your Single Level Downline keeps earning you money — no limit, no expiry.

BIOMONIE Affiliates

Build and turn your
downline into perpetual income.

BIOMONIE's Single-Level Downline Model (SLD) allows anyone and everyone to refer and earn when transactions are performed. It's transparent, transaction-based and always a NET-GAIN.

Refer Anyone and Everyone; Earn on Everything

Grow your downlines by introducing Customers, Merchants or Agents into the Ecosystem and earn a guaranteed payout on transactions they perform. Payouts into BIOWALLETS — no limit, no expiry.

Instant Payouts

Commissions and referral earnings are calculated and paid into your BIOWALLET once you meet the applicable transaction threshold.

No Limit. No Expiry.

No cap on how many people YOU can refer. Keep growing your downlines, earn forever as long as they perform transactions.

Earnings at a Glance
Referral Onboarding FeeAgents & Merchants onlyGuaranteed payout per referral
Activity-Based FeeFor everyone in the ecosystemEarn per transaction per defined activity thresholds
Referral PayoutsInstant — subject to Performance Activities
Activity Payout ThresholdEvery 75 transactions
Referral Earning ThresholdTied to Performance Activities
Who You Can ReferCustomers, Agents, Merchants
Payout MethodPaid into user's BIOWALLET
Cost to JoinAnnual Recurring Earned-Back Fees (NET-GAIN)
Earning ExpiryNone; continues Perpetually.
All earnings are transaction-based and only from users' downlines. The Single-Level Downline Model (SLD) governs the process. Everybody earns in the BIOMONIE ecosystem.
